title.narrative: Noakhali Integrated Response and Assistance for Protection Against Disasters (NIRAPAD)

description.narrative: The project will provide integrated humanitarian response to 300 flood-affected households in Char Elahi and Musapur unions, Companyganj upazila, Noakhali district. The project targets vulnerable populations including women-headed households, elderly, persons with disabilities, and adolescent girls. Key Activities includes cash & WASH support and livelihood recovery. Cash Assistance: 6,000 BDT unconditional cash to each of 300 households for urgent needs (food, medicine, transport) WASH Support: Hygiene kits (sanitary cloths, soap, antiseptic, flashlight) and tube well installation with 1,200-foot boring in both unions Agricultural Recovery: Aman rice seeds (1kg), vegetable seeds (5 varieties), and organic fertilizer (5kg) per household Expected Results Immediate (45 days): • 300 households meet urgent needs through cash assistance • Reduced health risks via improved water access and hygiene • Agricultural activities restart for food security • 80% beneficiary satisfaction with assistance Longer-term: • Faster recovery and reduced negative coping strategies • Sustained safe water access through permanent infrastructure • Enhanced agricultural self-reliance • Strengthened community resilience via planned DRR training Impact The project contributes to Start Network's Global Results Framework by meeting basic needs through dignified assistance, empowering local actors, reducing risks through early support, and building long-term resilience in flood-prone communities
